system.description:
Under the witch’s careful tending, the wear and tear of daily life disappears from cloth, wood and even metal. Meeting the obstacle repairs clothing and shoes; 1 success over mends tools, weapons or 1D of shield damage; 2 over mends 1D of armor; 3 over repairs stuff like gears or 2D of armor; 4 over repairs machines, like a mill, or large tools like a plowshare.

Obstacle: 4^. Actions: 27.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Single Target | Element: Earth | Impetus: Control | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 16

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 216
